places.name: Shimla
places.description: The capital of Himachal Pradesh, known for colonial architecture, mountain views, shopping streets, and pleasant weather.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; December to February for snow
places.entry_fee: Usually free; individual attractions may charge
places.opening_hours: City access throughout the day; attractions vary
visitor_notes: Traffic and parking can be difficult during peak season

places.name: Mall Road
places.description: Shimla’s main pedestrian shopping and leisure street lined with cafés, shops, colonial buildings, and viewpoints.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; December to February for snow
places.entry_fee: Free
places.opening_hours: Open throughout the day; shops have individual timings

places.name: The Ridge
places.description: A spacious open promenade offering views of the surrounding mountains and access to several historic landmarks.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; winter for snow
places.entry_fee: Free

places.name: Jakhu Temple
places.description: A hilltop temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman, featuring a prominent statue and panoramic views of Shimla.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Free
places.opening_hours: Usually open daily; timings may vary

places.name: Kufri
places.description: A popular high-altitude destination known for scenic meadows, winter snow activities, and mountain landscapes.
places.best_time_to_visit: December to February for snow; March to June for greenery
places.entry_fee: Varies by attraction and activity
visitor_notes: Roads may be slippery in winter

places.name: Manali
places.description: A popular Himalayan town known for river valleys, mountain scenery, adventure activities, and nearby attractions.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; October to February for snow
places.entry_fee: Usually free; individual attractions may charge
places.opening_hours: Town access throughout the day; attractions vary

places.name: Solang Valley
places.description: A scenic valley famous for paragliding, zorbing, skiing, snow activities, and mountain views.
places.best_time_to_visit: December to February for snow; March to June for adventure activities
places.entry_fee: Varies by activity

places.name: Rohtang Pass
places.description: A high mountain pass offering dramatic Himalayan scenery and seasonal snowfields.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to October, subject to permits and road conditions
places.entry_fee: Permit and transport charges may apply
places.opening_hours: Access depends on weather, permits, and official restrictions

places.name: Hadimba Devi Temple
places.description: A distinctive wooden temple dedicated to Hidimba Devi, set among cedar forests.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; October to February
places.entry_fee: Free
places.opening_hours: Usually open daily; timings may vary

places.name: Kasol
places.description: A riverside village known for forest trails, mountain scenery, cafés, and access to the Parvati Valley.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Free

places.name: Kheerganga
places.description: A popular trekking destination known for forest paths, mountain views, and natural hot-water springs.
places.best_time_to_visit: April to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: May include local or trail charges
visitor_notes: Use a local guide if inexperienced

places.name: Dharamshala
places.description: A mountain town known for Tibetan culture, monasteries, cafés, and views of the Dhauladhar range.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Usually free; individual attractions may charge

places.name: McLeod Ganj
places.description: A culturally rich hill settlement associated with Tibetan Buddhism, monasteries, markets, and cafés.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Usually free; attractions may charge
visitor_notes: Busy streets may have limited parking

places.name: Triund
places.description: A scenic trekking destination offering expansive views of the Dhauladhar mountains and Kangra Valley.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: May include forest, camping, or local charges
visitor_notes: Carry adequate water and warm clothing

places.name: Dal Lake Dharamshala
places.description: A small scenic lake surrounded by deodar trees and mountain landscapes.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Usually free or nominal
visitor_notes: Best combined with Naddi and McLeod Ganj

places.name: Khajjiar
places.description: A picturesque meadow surrounded by cedar forests, often called the Mini Switzerland of India.
places.best_time_to_visit: April to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Usually free; activities may be paid
visitor_notes: Winter access can be affected by snow

places.name: Dalhousie
places.description: A colonial-era hill station known for pine forests, churches, viewpoints, and relaxed mountain walks.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; December to February for snow
places.entry_fee: Usually free; individual attractions may charge
visitor_notes: Roads may be affected by winter weather

places.name: Chail
places.description: A peaceful hill destination known for forests, scenic viewpoints, and the historic Chail Palace.
places.best_time_to_visit: March to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Varies by attraction
visitor_notes: Ideal for a quieter alternative to Shimla

places.name: Great Himalayan National Park
places.description: A protected Himalayan landscape known for biodiversity, alpine habitats, forests, and trekking routes.
places.best_time_to_visit: April to June; September to November
places.entry_fee: Permits and guide charges may apply
places.opening_hours: Access depends on permits, routes, and weather
places.map_search: Great Himalayan National Park Himachal Pradesh

places.name: Spiti Valley
places.description: A high-altitude cold desert valley known for monasteries, stark landscapes, villages, and Himalayan adventure.
places.best_time_to_visit: May to October
places.entry_fee: Usually free; individual attractions may charge
places.opening_hours: Open throughout the day; access depends on roads
visitor_notes: Carry essential medicines and warm clothing
